text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To wait until morning and still get no 
reply... I feel like just collapsing right 
where I am...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I sent some research materials 
to an acquaintance's institute, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I stayed up waiting for that reply, and 
before I knew it, morning had come..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Still no word... ...This is bad...

Agnes Tachyon was swaying unsteadily, 
looking quite sleepy...
